answer: Make sybil resistance a cost that scales with the fleet, not a flat toll. Each identity must climb a reputation summit: every epoch it posts a fresh proof-of-work tied to its own key, so a gale of clones cannot share one solve. Chain eligibility across epochs — standing is a ridge you must hold: skip an epoch and slide back to zero, so fakes can't be held dormant. Weight rewards by cumulative unique non-kin co-attestors, so each mass-produced identity must recruit real peers. Attackers pay per identity, per epoch, in compute, continuity, and accomplices — nothing reusable.
